submitted.rationale: All five EQE values are close to zero (≤0.002%). This fits wide-gap Zn antimonates (Zn7Sb2O12, ZnSb2O6, gaps of 3.3 eV or more) lit with 2.4 eV photons, which is below the gap. Index 9 (Sb 0.45) gave the highest reading, 0.00198%. In its XRD a weak film peak at Q≈2.44 sits on top of the FTO SnO2 reflections, suggesting a mixed-phase region between the spinel and the trirutile.
